jars: Good advice won't take on someone set on ruin, like medicine on the dying.
Stop wasting your breath and let him hold his own smallness.
Do not hold yourself in contempt, and do not keep it going on too little.
Your worth is not his to measure.
best: You love him, and still every night the kitchen fills with his words and her tears.
day1_verdict: This is the exact feeling of being erased at the dinner table.
